description: Get one of your pages by slug: title, format, status, view/like counts, expiry, whether it is password-protected, and its current visibility / indexing / branding state. Never returns the page body or the password — call get_page_content when you need the source itself, and set_page_options to change any of the settings it reports.
name: get_page

brandingHidden.description: Whether the RENDERED page hides the dochost mark, resolved from the live plan — not a per-page setting. Read-only.

title: Get one of my dochost pages
